Bill.BriefDescription: Increasing accountability of regional transportation planning organizations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to membership of regional transportation policyboards; and amending RCW 47.80.040.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.80.040 and 1990 1st ex.s. c 17 s 56 are eachamended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each regional transportation planning organization shall create atransportation policy board. Transportation policy boards shallprovide policy advice to the regional transportation planningorganization and shall allow representatives of major employers withinthe region, the department of transportation, transit districts, portdistricts, and member cities, towns, and counties within the region toparticipate in policy making. Each member of a board must be aresident of this state and be employed by a business within this state.Any members of the house of representatives or the state senate whosedistricts are within the boundaries of the regional transportationplanning organization are ex officio policy board members with fullvoting powers. A regional transportation planning organizationencompassing a population of less than one million persons must include p. 1 SB 5387a representative from every incorporated municipality within theorganization.
